d.seg: నా నంబర్ ఇస్తే వాట్సాప్ లో ఫోన్ చేస్తాను
d.tr: If I give my number, I will call on WhatsApp
d.ctx: The user is asking to move the conversation to WhatsApp. The expert refuses to share her number.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp) and asking to share their number.
